definitions: To arrive or happen again in due course, often after a period of time.
To move by turning over and over in various directions within a confined space.
To spend time idly or aimlessly, often by moving from place to place.
examples: When the holidays rolled around, everyone was excited.
The dog rolled around in the grass.
They just rolled around all day, doing nothing productive.
pastTenses: rolled around (past simple), rolled around (past perfect)
